records.notes: Memorial of Saint Augustine, Bishop and Doctor of the Church.

celebrations.title: St. Augustine, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebrations.biographySummary: Great Doctor of Grace and Bishop of Hippo.

readings.text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not in wisdom of speech, lest the cross of Christ should be made void.

readings.response: The earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
readings.text: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye just: praise becometh the upright.
Then shall the kingdom of heaven be like to ten virgins, who taking their lamps went out to meet the bridegroom and the bride.

records.notes: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist.

celebrations.title: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist
celebrations.biographySummary: Martyrdom of the Fore-runner and Prophet of the Lord.

readings.text: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak to them all that I command thee.

readings.response: My mouth shall show forth thy justice.
readings.text: In thee, O Lord, I have hoped, let me never be put to confusion: deliver me in thy justice, and rescue me.
For Herod himself had sent and apprehended John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias.
